```{python}
import plotly.io as pio
pio.templates.default = "plotly_white"
import pandas as pd

skills_data = {
    "Name": ["Yasmine", "Wenjie", "Jinyi", "Yanyang"],
    "Python": [3, 4, 4, 4],
    "SQL": [4, 3, 4, 3],
    "Machine Learning": [3, 3, 3, 4],
    "Cloud Computing": [4, 4, 3, 3],
    "AWS": [4,4,4,4]
}

df_skills = pd.DataFrame(skills_data)
df_skills.set_index("Name", inplace=True)
df_skills
```

```{python}
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.set(style="white", font_scale=1.1)

ax = sns.heatmap(
    df_skills,
    annot=True,     
    cmap="coolwarm",    
    linewidths=1,    
    cbar_kws={'label': 'Skill Level'}, 
    square=True
)

plt.title("Team Skill  Heatmap", fontsize=16, pad=20)
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')
plt.yticks(rotation=0)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("figures/skillheatmap.png")
plt.show()

```


Each team member has a few areas to work on. Yasmine should focus on improving her Python and Machine Learning skills. Wenjie could spend more time strengthening SQL and Machine Learning. Jinyi would benefit from improving Machine Learning and Cloud Computing. Yanyang should work on building stronger SQL and Cloud Computing skills. To help with this, courses like "Python for Everybody" and "Machine Learning" on Coursera, " AWS cloud courses” would be useful. working on small group projects
